claims_and_derivations.claim: Physical total I and core R carry action units; mathcalI=I/hbar and qp j are dimensionless. A=hbar²/(2J). TW/LW refer to dominant qp orientation relative to core maximum-inertia axis, not fixed angle to total I/core R.
claims_and_derivations.locator: raw PDF1–2 geometry; PDF6 Eqs11–24; section3.3 notation
claims_and_derivations.conditions: Axis order and configuration specified; no universally fluid inertia assumption.

claims_and_derivations.claim: Frozen j along axis1 gives local leading-I coefficients C2=A2−A1+A1*j/I and C3=A3−A1+A1*j/I and hbar*omega=2I sqrt(C2 C3). Both C positive imply a positive-energy local minimum; real square root alone is weaker. Bosonic commutation uses mathcalI1≈I.
claims_and_derivations.locator: raw PDF6 frozen-alignment model, axes relabeled; manuscript FA-H through stability-condition; parent independent unexpanded-H controls
claims_and_derivations.conditions: Constant positive inertias, fixed j, small amplitude, large I. Not finite-I exact spectrum.

claims_and_derivations.claim: With fixed FA parameters LW energy increases; selected TW order J2>J1>=J3 softens at Ic=j/(1−J1/J2), but may first rise. Beyond Ic the frozen single-qp branch tilts in a principal plane, not a chiral trihedron.
claims_and_derivations.locator: raw PDF6 model discussion; manuscript frequency-squared-factors/critical-spin; parent derivative-sign controls
claims_and_derivations.conditions: No universal inference from rising/falling real-nucleus energies; model j and inertias can vary.

claims_and_derivations.claim: Ewob adjacent-yrast interpolation is for stated interleaved spin sequences; same-I difference is another legitimate reference. omega_rot=2A1(I−j)/hbar follows from leading branch energy.
claims_and_derivations.conditions: Explicit band, spin, parity and reference; no identification of every empirical difference as unique eigenfrequency.

claims_and_derivations.claim: Lu TSD observations and strong interband E2 support wobbling interpretation; short-axis alignment and inertia order are model quantities, not direct fluid-inertia measurements.
claims_and_derivations.locator: Odegard original mainPDF1–4; Jensen mainPDF1–4; Frauendorf PDF10 limitations
claims_and_derivations.conditions: No universal frequency slope/all-observable closure; quantitative comparison deferred to4.4.

claims_and_derivations.claim: Pr/La require separate inputs. LvPr M1-dominant links challenge tested E2-dominant interpretation; multiple inverse branches require common data/response. TiP and qp reorientation provide alternatives; absolute EM depends on configuration and operator.
claims_and_derivations.locator: Lv rawPDF3 Table1/Fig2; Lawrie model comparison; Matsuzaki rawPDF3–6 Eqs1–24
claims_and_derivations.conditions: No obligatory two roots, universally small M1 or universal1/I absolute strength law.
